source_id: CFR-GYM-001 / AFR-GYM-001 — create club happy path
purpose: Student Admin can create a new club by supplying all required fields; the club is recorded with open status.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated. Valid student IDs for coordinator and co-coordinator exist. Valid faculty ID for councillor exists.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/clubs/ with name, category='technical', coordinator_id, co_coordinator_id, faculty_councillor_id, description.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Response body includes status='open'. Club record created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-001 / AFR-GYM-002 — invalid coordinator rejected
purpose: Club creation is rejected when the coordinator ID does not refer to a valid student.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated. coordinator_id refers to a non-existent or non-student user.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Club is not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-001 / AFR-GYM-003 — invalid faculty councillor rejected
purpose: Club creation is rejected when the faculty_councillor_id does not refer to a valid faculty member.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated. faculty_councillor_id refers to a non-faculty user.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Club is not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-001 / AFR-GYM-004 — disallowed category rejected
purpose: Club creation is rejected when category is not one of technical, sports, or cultural.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated. All other fields valid.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Club is not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-001 / AFR-GYM-005 — new club recorded as open
purpose: A newly created club has status 'open' by default.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated. All fields valid.
expected_result: Response body contains status='open'. Database record confirms status='open'.

source_id: CFR-GYM-001 / AFR-GYM-006 — Student Admin confirms open club
purpose: Student Admin can approve an open club and change its status to confirmed.
preconditions: An open club exists. Student Admin is authenticated.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Club status changes to 'confirmed'.

source_id: CFR-GYM-002 / AFR-GYM-007 — Club Head changes leadership
purpose: The applicable Club Head can replace the club coordinator and co-coordinator.
preconditions: A confirmed club exists. The authenticated user is the current coordinator or co-coordinator. New coordinator and co-coordinator IDs are valid students.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/clubs/{id}/leadership/ with new coordinator_id and co_coordinator_id.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Club record reflects the new coordinator and co-coordinator.

source_id: CFR-GYM-002 / AFR-GYM-008 — invalid replacement leader rejected
purpose: Leadership change is rejected when either proposed replacement is not a valid student.
preconditions: Club exists. Authenticated user is current Club Head. New coordinator_id refers to a non-student user.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Leadership not changed.

source_id: CFR-GYM-002 / AFR-GYM-009 — only current leadership retained
purpose: After a leadership change, the club references only the new coordinator and co-coordinator; previous assignments are superseded.
preconditions: Club exists with original coordinator A and co-coordinator B. Club Head initiates change to C and D.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/clubs/{id}/leadership/ with valid new leader IDs.
expected_result: Club record shows coordinator=C and co_coordinator=D. A and B are no longer active leaders.

source_id: CFR-GYM-003 / AFR-GYM-010 — Club Head books session
purpose: Club Head can book a club session providing venue, date, start_time, end_time, description, and optional poster.
preconditions: A confirmed club exists. Authenticated user is the Club Head. Venue is in the configured list. No conflicting booking exists.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/session/ with valid venue, booking_date, start_time, end_time, description.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Session booking is created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-003 / AFR-GYM-011 — invalid time range rejected
purpose: A session booking is rejected when start_time is not before end_time.
preconditions: Club Head is authenticated with a confirmed club.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Booking not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-003 / AFR-GYM-012 — overlapping booking rejected
purpose: A session booking that overlaps an existing session in the same venue on the same date is rejected.
preconditions: An existing session booking occupies venue V on date D, 10:00-12:00. Club Head authenticated.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/session/ for venue V, date D, 11:00-13:00.
expected_result: HTTP 409 or HTTP 400. Booking not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-003 / AFR-GYM-012 — session-event cross-type overlap rejected
purpose: A session booking that overlaps an existing EVENT in the same venue on the same date is rejected.
preconditions: An existing event booking occupies venue V on date D, 10:00-12:00. Club Head authenticated.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/session/ for venue V, date D, 11:00-13:00.
expected_result: HTTP 409 or HTTP 400. Session not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-003 / AFR-GYM-013 — notification triggered after session booking
purpose: After a successful session booking, a notification task is dispatched to the intended student recipients.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Valid confirmed club and venue. No conflict.
expected_result: HTTP 201. A notification task is enqueued (outbox record or Celery task created).

source_id: CFR-GYM-003 / AFR-GYM-014 — Club Head books event with faculty councillor
purpose: Club Head can book a club event providing event details, faculty_councillor_id, venue, date, times, poster, and description.
preconditions: Confirmed club exists. Club Head is authenticated. Faculty councillor ID is valid. No conflicting booking.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/bookings/event/ with valid event fields including faculty_councillor_id.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Event booking created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-003 / AFR-GYM-015 — notification triggered after event booking
purpose: After a successful event booking, a notification task is dispatched to the intended student recipients.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Valid event data. No conflict.
expected_result: HTTP 201. A notification task is enqueued.

source_id: CFR-GYM-004 / AFR-GYM-016 — student applies for membership in confirmed club
purpose: A student can apply for membership in a confirmed club by providing a description.
preconditions: Student is authenticated. A confirmed club exists. Student has not previously applied to this club.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/memberships/apply/ with club id and description.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Membership application created with status='open'.

source_id: CFR-GYM-004 / AFR-GYM-016 — student cannot apply to open (unconfirmed) club
purpose: Membership application is rejected if the target club is not confirmed.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Club exists with status='open'.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Application not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-004 / AFR-GYM-017 — student may apply to multiple different clubs
purpose: A student with an existing application to Club A can submit a new application to Club B.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Applications to Club A already exist. Club B is confirmed and distinct.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Second application to Club B is created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-004 / AFR-GYM-018 — duplicate same-club application rejected
purpose: A student cannot submit a second membership application to the same club.
preconditions: Student authenticated. An existing application to Club A exists.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Duplicate application not created. Existing application unchanged.

source_id: CFR-GYM-004 / AFR-GYM-019 — new membership application has open status
purpose: A newly submitted membership application is recorded with status='open'.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Confirmed club exists. No prior application from this student.
expected_result: Response and database record show status='open'.

source_id: CFR-GYM-004 / AFR-GYM-020 — Club Head views pending applications
purpose: Club Head can access the list of pending (open) membership applications for their club.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. One or more open applications exist for the club.
action_or_input: GET /api/v1/gymkhana/memberships/ (filtered or scoped to the club).
expected_result: HTTP 200. Response includes the open applications for the authenticated Club Head's club.

source_id: CFR-GYM-004 / AFR-GYM-021 — Club Head approves membership with optional remarks
purpose: Club Head can approve an open membership application and optionally record remarks.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. An open membership application exists for their club.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Application status changes to 'confirmed'. Remarks stored.

source_id: CFR-GYM-004 / AFR-GYM-022 — approved membership transitions to confirmed
purpose: After approval, the membership application status is 'confirmed'.
preconditions: An open membership application exists. Club Head authenticated and authorized.
expected_result: Database record shows status='confirmed'.

source_id: CFR-GYM-005 / AFR-GYM-023 — Club Head creates voting poll
purpose: Club Head can create a voting poll with title, description, expiration date, at least two choices, and batch/branch target groups.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Confirmed club exists.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/polls/ with title, description, expires_at, two choices, and target_groups [{batch, branch}].
expected_result: HTTP 201. Poll created with status='active'.

source_id: CFR-GYM-005 / AFR-GYM-024 — poll with fewer than two choices rejected
purpose: Poll creation is rejected when fewer than two choices are supplied.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Poll not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-005 / AFR-GYM-025 — notification sent to target groups on poll creation
purpose: When a poll is created, a notification task is dispatched to the students in the selected target groups.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Valid target groups provided.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Notification task is enqueued for the target audience.

source_id: CFR-GYM-005 / AFR-GYM-026 — eligible student accesses active poll
purpose: An eligible targeted student can access an active poll and its choices.
preconditions: An active poll exists. Student is authenticated and belongs to the target batch/branch. Poll has not expired.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Poll detail including choices is returned.

source_id: CFR-GYM-005 / AFR-GYM-027 — eligible student casts one vote
purpose: An eligible targeted student can cast one vote in an active poll.
preconditions: Active poll exists. Student is eligible and has not voted. Poll not expired.
expected_result: HTTP 200 or 201. Vote recorded. Tally incremented for the selected choice.

source_id: CFR-GYM-005 / AFR-GYM-028 — duplicate vote rejected
purpose: A student who has already voted cannot cast a second vote in the same poll.
preconditions: Active poll exists. Student has already cast a vote.
expected_result: HTTP 400 or 409. Second vote not recorded. Tally unchanged.

source_id: CFR-GYM-005 / AFR-GYM-028 — tally atomically incremented on accepted vote
purpose: When a vote is accepted, the choice's vote_count is incremented by exactly 1.
preconditions: Active poll. Student eligible and not yet voted. Choice has vote_count=0.
expected_result: Choice C's vote_count becomes 1. Other choices unchanged.

source_id: CFR-GYM-006 / AFR-GYM-029 — Club Head submits budget request
purpose: Club Head can submit a club budget request with amount, purpose, description, and supporting file.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Confirmed club exists. Valid non-negative amount and file provided.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/budgets/ with amount>=0, purpose, description, supporting_file.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Budget request created with status='open'.

source_id: CFR-GYM-006 / AFR-GYM-030 — negative budget amount rejected
purpose: Budget request is rejected when the amount is negative.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Budget request not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-006 / AFR-GYM-030 — missing supporting file rejected
purpose: Budget request is rejected when the required supporting file is not provided.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Amount is non-negative.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Budget request not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-006 / AFR-GYM-031 — budget request stored as open with no approval flow
purpose: Submitted budget requests are stored with status='open'; no approval/rejection endpoint or transition exists.
preconditions: Valid budget request submitted.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/gymkhana/budgets/ with valid data, then GET /api/v1/gymkhana/budgets/{id}/.
expected_result: Status field is 'open'. No PATCH/PUT endpoint exists that changes status to approved/rejected.

source_id: CFR-GYM-007 / AFR-GYM-032 — Club Head submits event report
purpose: Club Head can submit a club event report with club, student_incharge, event_name, event_date, description, and report_file.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated. Confirmed club exists. All required fields including report_file provided.
expected_result: HTTP 201. Event report created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-007 / AFR-GYM-033 — missing report file rejected
purpose: Event report submission is rejected when the required report/details file is missing.
preconditions: Club Head authenticated.
expected_result: HTTP 400. Report not created.

source_id: CFR-GYM-007 / AFR-GYM-034 — assigned faculty councillor accesses reports
purpose: The assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access and review submitted event reports for their assigned club.
preconditions: Faculty Councillor is authenticated and assigned to Club X. At least one event report exists for Club X.
expected_result: HTTP 200. Response contains reports for Club X.

source_id: CFR-GYM-007 / AFR-GYM-034 — unassigned faculty cannot access reports
purpose: A faculty member not assigned as councillor to Club X cannot access Club X's event reports.
preconditions: Faculty member authenticated but assigned to Club Y, not Club X. Reports exist for Club X.
action_or_input: GET /api/v1/gymkhana/reports/ (or GET /api/v1/gymkhana/reports/{id}/ for a Club X report).
expected_result: HTTP 404 or empty list. No Club X report content is exposed.
